glycoprotein: a conjugated protein having a carbohydrate component
glycoside: a group of compounds derived from monosaccharides
glycosuria: the presence of abnormally high levels of sugar in the urine
glycyrrhiza glabra: deep-rooted coarse-textured plant native to the Mediterranean region having blue flowers and pinnately compound leaves
glycyrrhiza lepidota: North American plant similar to true licorice and having a root with similar properties
